notes.title: 1.0.1 Hotfix
notes.notes:
V1.0.1 

A small update for this one: 

[list]
[*]     Fixed an issue where challenge levels would always grant the “Hitless” achievement. 
[*]     Fixed an issue where Pilfer could potentially walk on lava. 
[*]     Fixed an issue where Pilfer’s second idle animation would not play. 
[*]     Fixed an issue where pressing the pause key during the level select screen would freeze the world. 
[/list]

The following issues are noted and are being monitored: 

[list]
[*] An issue where Pilfer could be damaged if a platform is above lava. 
[/list]
